properties.statement: [BL-193] An Interface CONSUMED across a component boundary with NO recorded spec makes the seam uncheckable — and no gap fires
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Same field report, 2026-08-03, run on the dynograph \u2192 foundation seam before an engine bump. detect_gaps returned silence.* The graph held cmp:dynograph \u2014CONSUMES\u2192 ifc:foundation_api with a name, a description and nothing else \u2014 no operations, no payload surface, no error model \u2014 so a release could change every signature behind that edge and the loop stays green. The seam had to be captured by hand (set_interface_spec) plus an external shell script written to make it checkable at all. This lands squarely on reflow2's own frontier and that is the strongest argument for it: maturity_report puts seams at 0% \u2014 0 of 73 component couplings declared through a contract \u2014 and 23 releases have shipped over that reading. Candidate: a gap for *\"an interface is CONSUMED across a component boundary but carries no spec.\"* The reporter's framing is the part to keep: *\"a check reduced to 'an edge exists' can only ever detect the edge disappearing.\"* Size M", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-193 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: M."}
